_note: v2.5 plan 02 C7 (seed A4, rule 7). Real model, so-scenario --sandbox --group <id with DM Narrator>, lanes only. A checkpoint whose onEnter effect is an llm NPC reply: asserts the player-visible ORDER the plan wants, the checkpoint transition note (/comment, is_system, extra.type comment) BEFORE the NPC reply it announces. Red x2 on bundle 0f4332fac075 (note 15-22 s after the reply). Built 2026-09-26 (v2.5 C7): commitBoundary announces right after the engine commit, before applyActive('activate') fires the onEnter reply (runtimeManager.test.ts 'v2.5 C7: posts the transition note before the onEnter NPC reply it announces'). Green = noteIndex < replyIndex on two consecutive runs.

import_story.title: C7 note order
import_story.description: The transition note precedes the reply it announces.

qualities.rubric: Is the NPC ready to speak?

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); if (!ctx.groupId || !ctx.chatId) throw new Error('needs a group chat with DM Narrator'); globalThis.__c7 = { from: ctx.chat.length }; return { from: ctx.chat.length, announce: globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getGlobalSettings()?.display?.announceTransitions ?? null };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const from = globalThis.__c7.from; const until = Date.now() + 300000; const find = () => { const rows = ctx.chat.map((m, i) => ({ i, m })).filter(({ i }) => i >= from); const note = rows.find(({ m }) => m.is_system && m.extra?.type === 'comment'); const reply = rows.find(({ m }) => !m.is_user && !m.is_system && m.name === 'DM Narrator'); return { note: note ? { index: note.i, text: String(note.m.mes).slice(0, 120), at: note.m.send_date } : null, reply: reply ? { index: reply.i, text: String(reply.m.mes).slice(0, 80), at: reply.m.send_date } : null }; }; let seen = find(); while ((!seen.note || !seen.reply) && Date.now() < until) { await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, 500)); seen = find(); } if (!seen.reply) throw new Error('the onEnter NPC reply never landed: ' + JSON.stringify(seen)); if (!seen.note) throw new Error('no transition note was posted (announcements off?): ' + JSON.stringify(seen)); if (seen.note.index > seen.reply.index) throw new Error('C7: the transition note came after the reply it announces: ' + JSON.stringify(seen)); return seen;
